name: enso_oni
description: Oceanic Nino Index (ONI), the standard measure of El Nino / La Nina, from NOAA Climate Prediction Center. Returns 3-month seasons (DJF..NDJ) with the Nino 3.4 sea-surface temperature, the anomaly in deg C, and the state the publisher's +/-0.5 C threshold implies (El Nino / La Nina / Neutral) with a strength band. Default: the latest 12 seasons, newest last. Use latest for "current ENSO state", or from_year/to_year for history (1950 onward).

latest.description: Return the most recent N seasons (default 12, max 200). Ignored when from_year or to_year is set.
